items.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28
items.summary: Fully funded one-year Master's study at participating UK universities, covering tuition, return airfare and a monthly living allowance.
items.eligibility: Nigerian citizens resident in Nigeria with at least an upper second-class first degree, who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK.

items.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027
items.organiser: Gates Cambridge Trust, University of Cambridge
items.deadlineNote: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, depending on your course
items.summary: Scholarships for postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge. Check the course funding deadline for the course you are applying to.
items.eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the UK applying for a full-time postgraduate course at Cambridge.

items.title: TEF Entrepreneurship Programme
items.deadlineNote: Portal opens 1 January and closes 1 March each year
items.summary: Business training, mentoring and US$5,000 in non-refundable seed capital for participants who complete the programme.
items.eligibility: Africans aged 18 or over, living in Africa, with a business idea or a business no more than five years old.

items.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
items.summary: Scholarships for study at partner universities in Africa and abroad. You apply directly to the partner institution you want to attend.
items.eligibility: Set by each partner institution. The Foundation never asks individuals for payment.
